notes.title: Patch 2.1
notes.content:
The recent update includes:
[list]
    
[*] New randomize button in the Lobby. The Server is now able to switch players around randomly that are not ready yet.
[*] Bug fixed where the player character would vanish like a decoy after it was teleported.
[*] Bubble active time and spawn percentage reduced.
[*] “Game Over” added for all players after the time runs out.
[*] Legendary Stealth-item fixed, now all players in a team will get the effect.
[*] Other minor visual fixes in the interface.

[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2.0
notes.content:
The recent update includes:
[list]
    
[*] Steam Achievements have been added.

[*] New Spectator modes: 3rd Person and Free Flow.
[*] The Server is no longer bound to play as a Hunter.
[*] It is now possible to join an ongoing game as a Spectator.
[*] New Feature: a countdown will end the game after 20 minutes.

[*] New Ability: Seekers are now able to resurrect fallen teammates.
[*] A faint light has been added to the character for better navigation in dark areas. This light can’t be seen by other players.
[*] Hunters can’t open and close doors quietly anymore.
[*] Quietly closed doors will not close completely.
[*] Seekers can no longer be killed by a single fire-spray.

[*] Added a timer for stealth, bubble and night vision items.
[*] Fixed a bug where the server could not start the game from the lobby.
[*] Player Timeout has been increased for a better connectability.
[*] Improved Physics behaviour and stability.
[*]Improved decal performance.
[*] Fixed a frequent crash that would occur when playing with 4 or more players.
[*] Nameplates will now always face the player.

[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.content:
The recent update includes:

[list]
[*]Shoggoth is now available in Japanese, Russian, Korean, Chinese (simplified) and Chinese (traditional).

[*]Introduced a very short cooldown (0.2 seconds) on all abilities. This prevents a rare case where you would lose control over your character while spamming an ability.

[*]Fixed an Issue with the decoy in connection with dragon fire.

[*]Improved search times in server list.

[*]Items are now stackable when bought from the in game shop.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31052180/52b01d58faa11d7fb2e322e80d65d4089d00ebf6.gif[/img]

The recent update includes:

[list]

[*]The UI has been updated to support more languages.

[*]Shoggoth is now available in German.

[*]Fixed an issue where players didn't get a character on game start with 4 or more players.

[*]Relevant gameplay tips now appear on the loading screen and at the end of each game.

[*]The score screen now saves data of leaving players.

[*]Added more Information in the Intro tips.

[*]Fixed an issue with disappearing nameplates.

[*]Fixed an issue where the hunter couldn't kill the seekers.

[*]Improved collision behavior between Characters.

[*]Both hunters are now red.

[*]System messages now appear when a player is caught or leaves the level.

[*]Fixed a game crash during level transfer.

[*]We greatly reduced the time it takes to connect to servers.


[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
The recent update includes:
[list]

[*]It is now possible to play as a Hunter during the Intro. An option in the escape menu was added to switch between Seekers and Hunters.

[*]Improved collision detection for entering landing mode. This prevents Characters from falling down unintentionally.

[*]Keys periodically emit sounds to better locate them. We added this information in the Intro.

[*]Fixed minor sound and interaction issues in the menu.

[*]Objectives in the Score Screen are now presented with respective icons.

[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31052180/52b01d58faa11d7fb2e322e80d65d4089d00ebf6.gif[/img]



The recent update includes:
[list]
[*]New spectator mode: You are now able to interact with the environment while spectating! Interactions invoke a 60 seconds cooldown. 

[*]Disappearing meshes on clients have been fixed.

[*]A workaround for the green flashing screen problem has been implemented. You can now launch your game in window mode. 

[*]The maximum number of hints you can find in the tutorial was corrected to 41.

[*]A connection problem was fixed, where the last server you played on would not list after leaving the game.

[*]Transforming into items now works while on the ground.

[*]Light shimmering through walls and floors has been reduced.
[/list]
